note: The same call with the granularity NOT asked for, recorded live on 2026-09-21 (S-129). subtitle_enable alone answers the provider’s default, which is sentence level: ONE ENTRY FOR THE WHOLE TEXT and no timestamped_words at all. This is what every narration of a real reel would have been given before this fixture existed, and what the adapter must not turn into word timings by splitting — splitting invents the milliseconds inside the entry. It is passed on as it arrived and the stage’s parse fails, loudly, at the boundary that owns the question (S-070, S-042).

body.text: Radar did not win the battle. The telephone did.
